module: "Playbook Attribute Viewer" window associated with editor_missionPlaybook. At each playbook step, it records the player's attributes (career_modules_playerAttributes.getAllAttributes: value, branch level, progress toward the next level) in resultData.attributes. The window displays for the current page a Key / Value / Tier / Change table (green for an increase, red for a decrease) and a curve of the attributes' evolution (except "money") via plotHelperUtil.
notes: The window is only drawn if the "Mission Playbook" window is visible.
Bug: M.onEditorRegisterPreferences is assigned to a global variable not defined in this file (nil); no effect.
The graph is conditioned by plotInvalid, set to true at each onPlaybookLogAfterStep; it therefore only appears after a first step has run.
The computation of "Change" reads prevData[key].value without checking that the key exists in the previous step.

show.desc: Shows the "Mission Playbook" and "Playbook Attribute Viewer" windows.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every frame: draws the attributes table and graph for book.results[book.page].

dt.desc: Frame duration in seconds (passed to the plot).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: registers the window (500x500), the "Missions" menu entry and creates the plot utility.

onPlaybookLogAfterStep.desc: Hook emitted by editor_missionPlaybook after each instruction: adds resultData.attributes = {key = {value, level, curLvlProgress, neededForNext}}.

resultData.desc: Result of the step, modified in place.
